title: Story premise EDU023: The Parcel Queue Remembers
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (computing/data). Hook: These parcels match. Which one should leave first? Takeaway/theme: Stable sorting preserves the prior order of equal-key items.
description: A dispatcher must sort parcels by destination while preserving arrival order within each destination, but an unstable reshuffle swaps two customers. Numbered tags make the mistake visible and a stable sort preserves both requirements.
